review_scope: Section D; fresh same-assistant report-only review

findings.title: Lock identity and recovery prose do not define exclusion across authorization replacement or stale owners
source_supported_facts: INPUT_LOCK_PREIMAGE includes generation_authorization_sha256; GENERATION_AUTH binds execution authorization. RUN_LOCK_PREIMAGE includes attempt_id; ATTEMPT binds execution_authorization_sha256 and ordinal1.
Runner requires conflicts to fail closed; stale input lock release/archive requires explicit authorization; state history and original refs immutable; no automatic retries.
Runner describes fsync, immutable receipt, CAS completion pointer, and explicitly authorized publish-only recovery.
derived_facts: Different authorization hashes for the same descriptor or run distinguish these lock identities; confirmed using fake metadata only.
Typed lock identities are not explicitly declared to be the filesystem or coordination exclusion keys. Consequently differing hashes are not evidence that an implementation would execute twice.
missing_evidence: Unique coordination domain keyed by semantic descriptor/run independent of reissued authorization, or a prohibition/revocation rule ensuring no two active authorizations for that domain.
Owner/lease record fields, expiration clock and lost-owner fencing, or an explicit no-takeover policy.

Compare-and-swap expected value/version and which writes/process starts require current ownership; interrupted publication reconciliation contract binding original receipt, inventory, pointer and recovery authorization.
findings.adversarial_metadata_example: identity_static_review_results.json#/checks ID-AUTH-LOCK-SEPARATION-OBSERVED; no production identities, seeds, locking or execution.
findings.consequence: Two implementations can choose different exclusion domains or lease takeover rules while satisfying the high-level words. Final duplicate checks cannot replace a pre-spawn at-most-once budget invariant. This is missing design semantics, not a demonstrated duplicate scientific run.
findings.recommendation: UNAPPROVED documentation clarification: choose either no takeover and one immutable active authorization per descriptor/run, or a fully specified owner/fencing/CAS protocol with authorization-independent exclusion. Preserve all failed attempts and zero automatic retries.
findings.exact_human_question: D09/D10采用哪一种明确的并发与失主处理契约：禁止自动接管并确保每个descriptor/run仅一份有效授权，还是规定可证明失主无法继续写入/启动的fencing与CAS协议？完整字段、授权替换和原子发布规则是否先补齐再批准？

findings.title: Actual executing Git identity and observed dirty status have no exact mandatory record binding
source_supported_facts: Original run manifest contract requires Git commit and dirty status. Runner32 explicitly distinguishes actual execution HEAD from frozen source bundle commit.

SCIENTIFIC_RUN_RECORD and PROCESS_RESULT are closed objects with no actual execution Git HEAD or observed dirty field. SOURCE_BUNDLE_PREIMAGE has frozen source_commit and dirty_policy, not the observed execution checkout.
raw_artifacts is a generic ARTIFACT_REF array; no required execution-provenance kind or typed body is specified.
derived_facts: A report-only metadata commit can change execution HEAD without changing frozen relevant source files. Frozen source_commit therefore does not identify the actual invoking checkout.
A rejection policy is a rule, not the recorded result of applying the dirty-state check.
missing_evidence: Explicit required provenance record or fields for actual execution HEAD and observed dirty status/scope, with exact source comparison and binding to the run/attempt completion inventory.
Exact source-body schema or required raw-artifact kind allowing another implementation to verify this requirement without inventing a record layout.
findings.consequence: The prose imposes the requirement, so omission is not semantically permitted; nevertheless the claimed exact typed schema has no normative location/type or mandatory artifact binding to satisfy it. Implementability and audit completeness remain unresolved.
findings.recommendation: UNAPPROVED clarification: add a mandatory typed execution-provenance receipt/ref, or required fields on a designated run/attempt record; retain frozen source identity separately, observed actual checkout and raw byte manifest separately.
findings.exact_human_question: 是否要求D10在批准前明确实际执行HEAD与实测dirty状态的必填类型、保存位置及COMPLETE绑定？采用专门provenance收据还是运行记录字段，并明确source_commit与actual_execution_HEAD的不同含义？

findings.title: Generation key contract says 15 fields; all three bindings and KEY contain exactly 14
source_supported_facts: The KEY required/properties set has 14 names; each of three binding objects has exactly the same 14 names.
key_binding_contract explicitly says All15 KEY fields produced exactly.
derived_facts: No missing fifteenth field is inferable or authorized. The closed typed set and all three bindings agree with one another.
missing_evidence: Corrected narrative count linked to the unchanged exact field set.
findings.consequence: Documentation count is false and should be corrected; adding an invented fifteenth field would alter keyed identity and violate the closed schema.
findings.recommendation: UNAPPROVED report recommendation: correct only All15 to All14 in a separately authorized documentation revision; retain exact key field sets.
findings.exact_human_question: 是否确认以现有14字段closed KEY为准，仅更正字段数量文字，不新增随机key字段？
